name: Happy New Year Lantern（新年快乐灯笼）
author: dzw6

sections.description:
This plugin displays a festive Chinese New Year lantern decoration on your site’s front-end while loading assets only when needed, in order to keep performance overhead low.

Features:

  • Configure from “Appearance → Customize → Happy New Year Lantern”: position, distance from top, scale, lantern spacing, swing strength, glow strength and lantern text.
  • Front-end minimize / expand button that remembers each visitor’s choice locally.
  • Option to show only on the home page or on all pages, plus a mobile visibility toggle.
  • Respects the prefers-reduced-motion setting and automatically disables animation when visitors have reduced motion enabled.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/wp-hny/, or upload the ZIP file via “Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin” in the WordPress admin.
  2. Activate “Happy New Year Lantern” on the “Plugins” screen.
  3. Go to “Appearance → Customize → Happy New Year Lantern” to adjust the styles.
  4. For basic display options you can also use the “Settings → Happy New Year” page.
sections.faq:
Why can’t I see the lantern?

Please check the following:
* The plugin is activated.
* You did not limit display to the home page while viewing a non‑home page.
* Mobile display is enabled if you are viewing the site on a mobile device.
* When using the “display on both sides” position, the lantern text contains an even number of characters.

Does the front-end minimize button affect all visitors?

No. The minimized / expanded state is stored only in the current visitor’s browser (local storage).
